page.layout: One printed page, the right-hand page of the scan. Top to bottom, one centred block of title lines, then a small printer's ornament, then the date line. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Margins are empty except for show-through from the other side and the edge of the left page, which are left out.

main_text.l: Cuius summa capita sequens pagina do-
Res olim varias in cœnis dipnosophistæ
Tractabant sermone vago: sed tempore nostro
De verbis tantùm cœnæ contentio sacræ
Orta, rapit cæcas furiosa in prælia mentes.
Quæ quanam dirimi possint ratione, libellus
Iste docet: quem tu suspenso, lector amice,
Perlege iudicio: nec te legisse pigebit.

page.notes: Small printer's ornament between the verse and the date, no text. The handwritten "2" at the upper right is not printed and is left out. Faint show-through of the reverse page is left out. The library label at lower left is left out.
